assertions: TikTok's documented GET /oembed endpoint returns the documented public example without an account, credential, cookie, scope, or user authorization.
The response preserves the exact requested VideoID, canonical URL, title, and bounded thumbnail dimensions.
The Connector uses one fixed www.tiktok.com endpoint, no redirect, no retry, and a 128 KiB response limit.
The normalized output excludes author identity, upstream HTML, thumbnail URL, metrics, comments, media bytes, tokens, cookies, and raw payloads.
